verdict.rationale: Skyfire supports agent-scoped API keys and per-token spend ceilings (committed amount, balance checks, expiry-based limits) via skyfire-docs-1, skyfire-supp-4, skyfire-docs-5, giving effective spend caps and usage limits per agent/token. However Skyfire's own docs state there is no per-token revocation API and that in-flight pay/kya-pay tokens remain chargeable until expiry plus a 24-hour grace period even after account deactivation, so 'instant' revocation of payment authority is not delivered (skyfire-supp-6, skyfire-supp-5). missing for 10: a documented instant per-agent/per-token revocation mechanism, real-time usage-limit dashboards beyond token amount/expiry, and any independent/hands-on confirmation of these controls in practice.
